definitions.standard: A stable subatomic particle occurring in all atomic nuclei, with a positive electric charge equal in magnitude to that of an electron, but of opposite sign.
definitions.simple: A tiny, invisible particle that lives right in the center of an atom. It has a positive charge, like the plus side of a battery.
definitions.scientific: A hadron, composed of two up quarks and one down quark, found in the nucleus of every atom. It carries a positive charge of +1 e.

examples: The hydrogen nucleus is a single proton

common_misconceptions: Protons orbit the nucleus. (No, protons ARE the nucleus, along with neutrons).
tutor_context.tutor_hint: Remember 'P' for Proton and 'P' for Positive!
